title: Liquidity-shock reversal: abnormally high activity after an up move predicts a pullback
mechanism: Attention-driven buying creates temporary price pressure when trading activity spikes after a price rise. The pressure is inventory-driven rather than information-driven, so it decays over subsequent days as market makers re-hedge and early buyers realise gains.
signal_concept: Recent trading activity relative to its own recent baseline, measured after a price rise. Higher abnormal activity marks stronger temporary pressure and a larger expected pullback.
applicability: US large-cap equities with at least 60 trading days of history
failure_modes: news regimes where the activity spike carries genuine information
names whose baseline activity is too noisy to define abnormal
novelty_rationale: Recent records cover generic short-horizon reversal; this idea conditions on the activity spike and the prior up-move state.

title: Close-position persistence: repeated end-of-day demand absorption predicts continuation
mechanism: When the close repeatedly sits near the top of the daily range, end-of-day buying is absorbing available supply. If that demand is institutional and gradual, the accumulation is not finished and continues into following sessions.
signal_concept: The average position of the close inside the daily high-low range over a recent window. A higher average position indicates persistent demand-side pressure.
applicability: liquid equities where the closing auction is meaningful
regimes without dominant end-of-quarter window dressing
failure_modes: closing-auction distortions around index or quarter-end events
thin names where the daily range is dominated by a single print
novelty_rationale: Existing records use single-day range position; this idea looks at persistence of the position across days and interprets it as ongoing absorption.

title: Overnight move reversal: the overnight return channel partly reverses during the next sessions
mechanism: Overnight moves are dominated by retail attention and liquidity gaps while continuous-session trading is dominated by institutions. Inventory taken overnight is unwound once deeper liquidity arrives during the session.
signal_concept: The overnight component of the most recent return, measured separately from the open-to-close component. A larger positive overnight move indicates more temporary overnight demand and a higher expected reversal.
applicability: single liquid index instrument with reliable open prints
failure_modes: macro announcements that move the instrument permanently
sessions where the open print is stale or auction-distorted
novelty_rationale: Recent time-series records use total return; this idea isolates the overnight channel and its reversal.
